title: Sub-Account Direct Trading Prevention (LPOA Lockout)
precondition: Sub-account actively bound to MAM manager.
steps: 1. Investor attempts to manually open an order from personal MT5 terminal.
expected: Order rejected by broker server with 'Trade Disabled (Account managed under LPOA)'; investor cannot interfere with manager strategy.
coverage_note: Current platform permits independent follower trades. Original LPOA direct-trading lockout requirement is not demonstrated.
